Internal helper: the Word file's name, .docx added where it is left off

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_table_file_name.Rd

Session 430, the (S429) .docx item (Jeff: "do we really need to specify the file extension in the syntax? ... We're always writing to a .docx right?"). jtable() writes Word files only, so a name with no extension, or one whose ending is no file format's ("Report.v2", "Table 1.2026"), gets .docx, as jsave() gives a saved result's file .rds (ruling R91); until v0.9.288 each stopped with a fragment of a call, and "Report.v2" was offered "Report.docx". A name ending in another format's extension stops, saying the table is written to a Word file, with the call as typed and the name ending in .docx. A figure's companion files take the final name, as they are made from it.

Usage

.jst_table_file_name(file, cl, mc)

Arguments

file

The file argument, checked as text.

cl, mc

The call as typed and the matched call.

Value

The name to write, ending in .docx.
